notes.title: Update for All Seekers ✨
notes.content: [p]Friends, we're thrilled to present this major update! We've put our heart into every detail to make your favorite hidden object game even cozier and more engaging.[/p][p]What's new:[/p][list][*][p]New languages added[/p][/*][*][p]Fresh achievements for keen explorers[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother gameplay with bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Hidden improvements to discover[/p][/*][/list][p]🔍 Immerse yourself in this charming world of mysterious farms, sweet bakeries and ancient castles. Every found item brings joy![/p][p]Thank you for your support. Update now and enjoy![/p]
